title: Aspose CLI result window
description: How much of a larger collection a bounded read or search returned, and the ready-to-run command that continues it.

unit.description: What returned and total count, e.g. page, slide, block, cell or hit.

returned.description: How many units this result returned.

total.description: How many units the selection holds; omitted when the read stopped before counting them all.

truncated.description: Whether units remain after the returned ones, or the last one was cut short.

next.description: The command that returns the next window, ready to run; omitted when nothing remains.
